主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. held a special virtual meeting for Series B Preferred Shares holders. The meeting was originally scheduled for October 13, 2021, but a quorum was not present. The meeting was adjourned to November 23, 2021, and then again to January 6, 2022. Despite multiple adjournments, no quorum was established, and no Preferred Directors were elected by the holders of Series B Preferred Shares.
